mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_job (report_id, account_id, patient_id, idempotency_key, status, epoch, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{accountId}, #{patientId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{epoch}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT report_id AS reportId, account_id AS accountId, patient_id AS patientId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, status, epoch, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM report_job WHERE report_id = #{reportId}

SELECT report_id AS reportId, account_id AS accountId, patient_id AS patientId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, status, epoch, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM report_job WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
